about: The room page's theme-colour effect (the browser chrome takes the guest's tint) to hooks/use-theme-color.ts, and its three redirects (a removed guest to the join page, a link without its token to the join page, a closed room to the start page) to hooks/use-room-redirects.ts, in that order inside one hook. The table holds for the tree of the commit that added it (git log --diff-filter=A -- scripts/step6/tables/web-room-chrome-hooks.json): later moves take more lines out of the page. From the repo root, with that commit checked out in <folder>: node scripts/step6/web-move-check.mjs scripts/step6/tables/web-room-chrome-hooks.json --root <folder>, and node scripts/step6/hook-order.mjs "apps/web/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx" --root <folder> --base 1787b7d --strict

apps/web/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx: useRoomRedirects({ participantId, tokenMissing, roomState, me, router });
